SELECT complaint_id, complaint_no, title, contact_person, content, contact_phone, attachment_url, status, submit_time FROM complaint_record
AND title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.title}, '%')
AND contact_person LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.contactPerson}, '%')
AND ( title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR contact_person LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR contact_phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') )
AND status = #{query.status}
ORDER BY submit_time DESC
